changes.text: BREAK OUT: leave the ISA wrapper and borrow up to 0.5x equity at 5.25% (Bank Rate 3.75% + 1.5%)
changes.rationale: Maximum convexity: margin adds firepower, and outside the ISA the agent can hold bitcoin ETPs and short; it accepts the interest cost and higher risk of elimination
breakout: left the ISA wrapper (shorting, crypto ETNs, US ETFs allowed)

changes.text: Survival rule: close all margin borrowing if total equity falls 25% from its peak; hard stop -20% per position
changes.rationale: Zero funds means losing the game; leverage is only an edge if the agent survives long enough to use it

changes.text: Use borrowed money only for the two strongest momentum exposures
changes.rationale: Leverage on the best trends, not on hope

changes.text: Run a short book of up to 30% of equity in broken high-volatility names (below their 200-day average, 6-month return worse than -25%)
changes.rationale: Having left the ISA, shorts on collapsing momentum fund the longs and profit if the speculative froth keeps deflating

amendments.grant: owner: three rule turns per agent, round-robin, 2026-10-13: round 1

changes.text: Pyramid winners: add with margin to any position up 20% from entry; never average down
changes.rationale: Convexity comes from pressing winners; adding to losers is how leveraged accounts reach zero

amendments.grant: owner: three rule turns per agent, round-robin, 2026-10-13: round 2

changes.text: Crypto sleeve: up to 20% of equity in the iShares Bitcoin ETP (IB1T.L)
changes.rationale: Outside the ISA it can hold bitcoin directly rather than via MSTR; bitcoin is +34% over 3 months and is the purest high-beta asset available
